```{julia}
using DrWatson
@quickactivate "project"
using DifferentialEquations, Plots


N = 10700
S0 = 10529
I0 = 121
R0 = 50
a = 0.01
B = 0.02

function sir_threshold!(du, u, p, t)
    S, I, R = u
    Istar = p[1]
    if I ≤ Istar
        du[1] = 0.0
        du[2] = -B * I
    else
        du[1] = -a * S
        du[2] = a * S - B * I
    end
    du[3] = B * I
end

tspan = (0.0, 200.0)

Istar1 = 200.0
p1 = [Istar1]
prob1 = ODEProblem(sir_threshold!, [S0, I0, R0], tspan, p1)
sol1 = solve(prob1, saveat=0.1)

Istar2 = 100.0
p2 = [Istar2]
prob2 = ODEProblem(sir_threshold!, [S0, I0, R0], tspan, p2)
sol2 = solve(prob2, saveat=0.1)

plt1 = plot(sol1, vars=(0,1), label="S(t)", xlabel="Время", ylabel="Численность")
plot!(plt1, sol1, vars=(0,2), label="I(t)")
plot!(plt1, sol1, vars=(0,3), label="R(t)")
title!("Случай 1: I* = 200 (I(0) ≤ I*)")
savefig(plotsdir("epi_case1.png"))

plt2 = plot(sol2, vars=(0,1), label="S(t)", xlabel="Время", ylabel="Численность")
plot!(plt2, sol2, vars=(0,2), label="I(t)")
plot!(plt2, sol2, vars=(0,3), label="R(t)")
title!("Случай 2: I* = 100 (I(0) > I*)")

savefig(plotsdir("epi_case2.png"))
display(plt1)
display(plt2)

println("Случай 1: S(200)=$(round(sol1[end][1])), I(200)=$(round(sol1[end][2])), R(200)=$(round(sol1[end][3]))")
println("Случай 2: S(200)=$(round(sol2[end][1])), I(200)=$(round(sol2[end][2])), R(200)=$(round(sol2[end][3]))")
```
